name: raycast-import
title: Raycast Import
description: Import data exported from Raycast (snippets, clipboard history, emoji, extensions) into Vicinae.
author: danielfstefan

commands.name: import-data
commands.title: Import Raycast Data
commands.description: Import snippets, clipboard history, emoji, and Raycast extensions from a Raycast export (.json or encrypted .rayconfig)

commands.name: import-background
commands.title: Import Raycast Data (background)
commands.description: Headless helper: replays clipboard history through Vicinae's recorder and installs the picked extensions from the official Raycast store. Launched automatically by 'Import Raycast Data' — no need to run this directly.
